desc:
👊 PUNCH WALL ESCAPE JAIL 👊
You're locked in a cell... and the only way out is THROUGH the wall! 🧱 Punch your way to freedom solo or with a crew of up to 4! 🔓

🎮 HOW TO PLAY
👊 Click or tap (or just hold) to punch the wall
🎒 Broken blocks fly straight into your backpack
🚽 Dump your backpack in the toilet to turn rubble into cash 💰
⬆️ Open UPGRADES (TAB) to punch harder, dig bigger holes and carry more
🔑 Break through every layer, grab the key and ESCAPE! 🏃

✨ FEATURES
🔥 FURY MODE: punch to fill the meter, then unleash a burst of power
⭐ Golden blocks worth 10x and crit punches that hit 5x
💎 Hidden secret stashes inside the wall
📋 Objectives that pay out bonus cash
🕶️ Black Market deals from Bob
🌳 A huge upgrade tree to get stronger every run
🏆 Leaderboards for escapes, blocks and furies

💡 TIPS
🎒 Empty your bag before it fills up!
❓ New? Press the ? button for How to Play
🆘 Stuck? Use the STUCK button

👍 LIKE and ⭐ FAVORITE for updates! 🔔
